statements.status_notes: Drydock builds this unique APK revision from checksummed zlib 1.3.2 source with upstream fix df84af25dc1942490e1d1c899a07619152a46148. The build runs upstream tests and verifies failed gzip writes clear external input state. No other version or vulnerability is covered. See docker/zlib/README.md.

statements.impact_statement: The affected implementation is optional contrib/infback9 (inftree9.c), not standard libz. This exact APK uses the standard zlib 1.3.2 shared-library build, whose object lists exclude infback9. Immutable published 1.7.0 and 1.7.1-rc.5 images were inspected on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64: no infback9/inftree9 paths or GDAL library, and no inflateBack9 or inflate_table9 symbols in libz, with ordinary zlib symbols present as controls. No other APK revision or vulnerability is covered. Evidence and immutable image digests: https://github.com/CodesWhat/drydock/pull/1544#issuecomment-6713748413. Upstream scope: https://github.com/madler/zlib/pull/1235.
